title: Bound Accepted checkpoint accounting retries while an independent enclosure remains held
outcome: A durably accounted original component does not churn persistence at the fast retry cadence or report complete settlement while an independently unsettled enclosing duty correctly prevents release.
acceptance: An Accepted original blocked by an independently unsettled selected enclosure reports held rather than settled and avoids unbounded fast-cadence accounting writes, without acquiring the enclosure's shared-ID release latch.
Actual adopted-duty witnesses show bounded tick and explicit-accounting behavior, durable original receipt and effects, retained independent exclusion and no extra checkpoint or provider delivery.
Failed first publication or acknowledgement and restart remain recoverable; suppressing redundant accounting cannot mistake unproved in-memory effects for an acknowledged durable cut.
